title: Scripture names every kind of sin to heal
english: Scripture hides no species of sin; the Word sent to heal names them all. True prophets minister God’s words; [[false prophets >> Bible:Ezekiel 13:1-3]] are teachers whose talk or life denies the discipline they preach.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).

title: Glad when the Word rebukes our order
english: Rejoice when Scripture warns us off vices — still more when God’s word strikes our own rank so we turn and are healed. Glory to God. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Ezekiel).
